summary.headline: Arotech captures $320K in verified annual savings across six spend categories
summary.narrative: Treya Partners helped Arotech lock in $320,069 of annualized savings by completing or advancing sourcing initiatives in six indirect and COGS categories. Two categories (Rave Computer hardware and Audio-Visual/IT COGS) are fully implemented and delivering $220K in recurring benefit. Four additional categories – Car Rental, Hotels, Amazon IT peripherals and MRO – have completed negotiations and are now in the client signature / roll-out phase representing a further $100K in savings once activated. Key wins include double-digit rate reductions through the OMNIA GPO for travel, a dual-source MRO strategy, and migration of Amazon IT spend to a lower-cost reseller.
